Quicksilver Gheists.descrizione:
VANISH AND REAPPEAR: Declare: Pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit that is in combat to use this ability.
 Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.

Shrieker Host.fase_attivazione: Hero Phase (Fase Eroi Amica o Nemica)
Shrieker Host.descrizione:
PETRIFY: Declare: Pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT HERO to be the target.
 Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with the target.

Death Stalkers.fase_attivazione: Hero Phase (Fase Eroi Amica o Nemica)
Death Stalkers.descrizione:
THERE IS NO ESCAPE: Declare: If there is not a condemned enemy unit on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit to be condemned.
 Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks made by friendly NIGHTHAUNT units that target the condemned enemy unit.

Royal Procession.fase_attivazione: Hero Phase (Fase Eroi Amica o Nemica)
Royal Procession.descrizione:
LETHAL RANCOUR: Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly NIGHTHAUNT units to be the targets.
 Effect: The targets’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) for the rest of the turn.

Hungry Nexus.descrizione:
GREEDY FOR SOULS: Declare: Pick a friendly Nexus of Grief to be the target.
 Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has a Move characteristic of 3". It can immediately move up to 3" and can move into combat but cannot end that move on a terrain feature or within 3" of an objective.

Deathrust Gheists.fase_attivazione: Hero Phase (Fase Eroi Amica o Nemica)
Deathrust Gheists.descrizione:
BLADES OF ETERNAL RUST: Declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly NIGHTHAUNT units to be the target.
 Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
